what: A street name sign: a metal post with one blank rectangular name board. The game writes the street's real name on the board from World data's streets.json.

size.note: The Nigerian road-sign manual (Federal Ministry of Works Highway Manual Part 1 Vol. VI, 2013) was found but its size tables could not be read; no Lagos street-sign standard found. Board colour also needs the owner (from memory or his own photos).

prompt.subject: street name sign, one round galvanised metal post with a single blank flat rectangular board fixed near the top, board face completely plain
prompt.style: stylised game prop, simple clean shapes, flat colours, no text, no logos, no lighting or shadows painted into the texture
